inputs.prompt: Studio product photograph of one compact camera drone for everyday personal aerial photography, seen from directly above in a strict orthographic top view, centered on a seamless white background with a soft contact shadow. A quadcopter with four arms, one motor at the end of each arm and one two-blade propeller on each motor. The nose points toward the top edge of the picture. A small forward-facing gimbal camera sits under the nose; from above only the top of its housing shows at the front edge, and the lens faces forward, not upward. Form language: a faceted wedge-shaped body with crisp chamfered edges and flat planes, with clearly separate arm modules attached to the body. Materials: fine-textured matte polycarbonate body shell in light warm gray, darker graphite-gray arms and motor mounts, satin anodized aluminium motor bells, semi-gloss black propellers, glossy black camera glass, thin precise panel seams. Soft overhead softbox lighting with gentle highlights on edges and chamfers.
